summary: Steep narrow lane squeezed between houses, with no stopping signs.

drivers.seclusion: Detached house 2 m away at 25 m and apartments 5 m at the north end; homes line the lane.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane with no verge; nowhere to pull out of the lane.
drivers.convention: No cars park along the lane; two No Stopping Any Time signs.

sun_shade: Mixed tree shade over the lane, mostly from the east.
